worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.summary: Vault to the aimed side and cut in along a short side arc; the first real contact on that arc lands the blow, then the momentum carries you past. Holding no item doubles the vault's power. With no room on either side you only make a short close strike.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.use.0: A light side vault while empty-handed
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.use.1: Vault in from the target's flank to reposition
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.use.2: A plain Flying strike while carrying a heavy item
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.description: The side-arc contact deals about %1$s Flying contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; while you hold no item it is doubled, and the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

Vault out to the aimed side and cut in along a short side arc: up to %1$s blocks and %2$s blocks per tick from takeoff to contact, with a small lift over low obstacles. After contact the momentum rounds the target's body about %3$s blocks farther; with no room on either side you only make a short close strike or whiff.
A landed hit shoves the target about %1$s blocks along the vault.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.sweep.on: Long sweep on: a longer side arc and momentum, but the blow is x0.9 and recovery is 3 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.sweep.off: Long sweep off (tight arc): the blow is x1.1 and recovery is faster, with a shorter side arc and momentum.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.growth.0: At level %1$s, Acrobatics power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.growth.1: At level %1$s, Acrobatics power rises to %2$s and the cut-in distance to %3$s.
On: side arc and momentum about x1.3, but the blow is x0.9 and recovery 3 ticks longer. Off: a tight arc for x1.1 power and a faster recovery, with a shorter arc.
Only vaults in within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to vault in. Off: it only vaults when the target is already in reach.
On: only used while you carry no item, to take the doubled vault. Off: it also fills in as a plain Flying strike while carrying something.
